method: Two passes over the hostnames this repository's own scan of 2,017 mainland origins collected: leading labels matching advertising-delivery conventions, and leading labels matching tracking and analytics conventions, plus hostnames surfaced under roots the product still routes direct. Every verdict is derived from the shipped corpus - admit means advertising-curated is what the host first-matches - so this file cannot disagree with the product. Admission requires per-host review, a live A record, and criterion 2 of docs/SELF-OWNED-REBUILD.md: third-party to an observing origin, or a dedicated advertising or tracking endpoint of the operator whose site referenced it. admission_route records which of the two applies.
